Based on CWE-258 "Empty Password in Configuration File", here are the necessary weakness indicators to detect in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scripts:

## Core Indicators

### Credential-Related Fields
- Attributes explicitly named `password`, `pwd`, `passwd`, `secret`, `credential`, `auth_token`, `api_key`, `access_key`, `secret_key`
- Authentication-related properties with suffixes indicating password nature (`_password`, `_secret`, `_key`, `_token`)

### Empty Value Patterns
- Empty string assignments (`""`, `''`, or equivalent)
- Null or undefined values in password contexts
- Whitespace-only values that evaluate to empty or trivial passwords

### Configuration Context Markers
- Resource types related to: databases, user accounts, IAM/identity providers, external services, network appliances
- Connection strings or URI components containing credential segments
- Environment variable declarations for sensitive credentials
- Secret management system references with literal empty values

## Structural Clues

### Assignment Patterns
- Key-value pairs where the key matches password semantics and the value is absent or trivial
- Template expressions evaluating to empty defaults
- Conditional assignments where the fallback path sets empty credentials

### Encoding/Format Hints
- Base64-encoded empty strings (e.g., empty string encoded)
- URL-encoded credential segments in connection strings
- Placeholder substitution patterns leaving password segments vacant

## Contextual Risk Amplifiers

- Resources with `public_access` enabled alongside weak credentials
- Production-environment indicators combined with simplified authentication
- Legacy compatibility flags that may bypass password requirements
- Default or example configurations propagated unchanged

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

# Define sensitive credential field patterns
password_keywords := {"password", "pwd", "passwd", "secret", "credential", "auth_token", "api_key", "access_key", "secret_key"}
password_suffixes := {"_password", "_secret", "_key", "_token", "_pwd", "_passwd", "_credential"}

# Check if field name matches password semantics
is_password_field(name) {
    lower_name := lower(name)
    password_keywords[lower_name]
} else {
    lower_name := lower(name)
    suffix := password_suffixes[_]
    endswith(lower_name, suffix)
}

# Check if value is empty or trivial
is_empty_value(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    value.value == ""
} else {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("^[\\s]*$", value.value)
} else {
    value.ir_type == "Null"
} else {
    value.ir_type == "Undef"
}

# Find all KeyValue elements recursively in a value node
find_keyvalues(node) = kvs {
    kvs := {kv |
        walk(node, [_, n])
        n.ir_type == "KeyValue"
        kv := n
    }
}

# Check nested structures for empty password fields
check_nested_empty_password(value) {
    attr := glitch_lib.all_attributes({}|{value.:""})[_]
    is_password_field(attr.name)
    is_empty_value(attr.value)
} else {
    kvs := find_keyvalues(value)
    kv := kvs[_]
    is_password_field(kv.name)
    is_empty_value(kv.value)
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    
    # Check in atomic unit attributes
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    unit := atomic_units[_]
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(unit)
    attr := attrs[_]
    
    is_password_field(attr.name)
    is_empty_value(attr.value)
    
    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration file - Password fields should not be empty or contain only whitespace. (CWE-258)"
    }
}

}

package glitch

password_exact := {"password", "pwd", "passwd", "secret", "credential", "auth_token", "api_key", "access_key", "secret_key"}
password_suffixes := {"_password", "_pwd", "_passwd", "_key", "_token"}

is_password_field(name) {
    lower_name := lower(name)
    exact := password_exact[_]
    lower_name == exact
} else {
    lower_name := lower(name)
    suffix := password_suffixes[_]
    endswith(lower_name, suffix)
    not startswith(lower_name, "cache_")
    not contains(lower_name, "_cache_")
    not startswith(lower_name, "gitlab_runner__api")
}

is_empty_value(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    count(trim_space(value.value)) == 0
} else {
    value.ir_type == "Null"
} else {
    value.ir_type == "Undef"
}

all_variables(node) = vars {
    vars = {n |
        walk(node, [path, n])
        n.ir_type == "Variable"
    }
}

all_attributes(node) = attrs {
    attrs = {n |
        walk(node, [path, n])
        n.ir_type == "Attribute"
    }
}

check_hash_empty_pass(hash_val) = found {

        walk(hash_val, [_, node])
        node.ir_type == "Hash"

        is_password_field(k)
        is_empty_value(node.value[k])
        v := node.value[k]
